response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer (15+ years) with strong distributed-systems, low-latency, and event-driven work, plus real high-throughput microservice experience at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby. However, the role is fundamentally a C++ engineering position in industrial automation, and his C++ exposure is limited to a six-month stint at National Instruments (2014-2015) and a university thesis project — over a decade ago. There is no evidence of STL-heavy modern C++, IEC 62443 / Secure Development Lifecycle practice, MQTT or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850), or Azure. His core stack is TypeScript/Node/D/web, which does not map to the primary technical competencies required.
strengths: Deep experience with low-latency, event-driven, high-throughput distributed systems
Strong engineering-craft culture: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, mentoring and public workshops
Broad polyglot range across backend, embedded-adjacent, mobile and DevOps work
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and roughly a decade stale; no modern C++/STL evidence
No industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL, MQTT, or OT protocol background
Career trajectory is web/cloud full-stack, not systems/platform C++ engineering
